title: SEO & Copywriting Specialist | Digital Marketing Specialist
focus: SEO content • destination guides • digital marketing
body: At Bluetent / Inhabit, I developed SEO-focused website copy, destination guides, blog articles, and digital marketing content for vacation rental clients across the country. I balanced keyword research and on-page SEO with storytelling that helps readers find genuinely useful answers.

title: Content Writer
body: I created SEO-focused content for Renterverse and Rental Manager, producing multiple blog posts each week for renters and landlords. I conducted UX testing, analyzed user data, researched keywords, and optimized articles using SEMrush and Google Search Console. I also collaborated with SEO specialists, UX/UI designers, and product teams on content development and product launches.
